searchText: Reminder to review some of the open Gloas PRs: * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+label%3Agloas Especially this one: * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4788 I plan to merge several of these this week. Ah yeah you're completely right, I forgot it worked that way 😄 Nevermind then As we not gonna have anymore epbs breakout rooms, and we gonna be moving epbs discussion topics to ACDT, it would be good to start having actual delivery deadlines for epbs only devnets. Could I get an update on the latest on the specs? Once we have 4788 merged in, could we get a "spec freeze" for devnet 0? I agree, it would be good to have a specs release this week at some point Sounds good to me Yes, I plan to make a spec release. I've just been waiting for client teams to approve the PR(s). hard to get a spec freeze with such a major change coming in feature freeze may be, but still we rely on spec releases to be able to even review code in our branches Francesco's changes are kinda irrelevant cause they are not consensus breaking, so we can include them or not, it doesn't matter, but Justin's need to be merged and it will take surely a couple of back and forth to set the spec frozen I have merged 4788 <@520034910149410861> can you submit a PR which updates `is_head_weak` and `is_parent_strong` to properly use the updated `get_weight` function? It's not obvious to me how to do this. Ah I see that you've updated `is_head_weak` in your "finishing touches" PR 🙂 We should update `is_parent_strong` there too. I updated `is_parent_strong` there, had to change the input from `parent_root` to `root` because you need `root` to derive the `parent_node`, inclusive of `payload_status`, which is what we need for `get_weight`/`get_attestation_weight` . I decided to change the input to `root` everywhere, in other specs as well, to just have one consistent way of using the function throughout. A note about `get_attestation_weight`: it was introduced to avoid an infinite loop in `is_head_weak`, since `should_apply_proposer_boost` in `get_weight` calls `is_head_weak` again. I think it makes sense to also use it in`is_parent_strong` to avoid proposer boot influencing the result. Is this ok, or should I make a separate PR with these in case we want to merge them before the whole fork-choce PR? This looks good, thank you! I intend to merge this PR soon. <@363800010518822915> <@755590043632140352> could you give [4807](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4807) another review? Started the `v1.7.0-alpha.0` release: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/actions/runs/20729286454 looks good to me, will need to work on spec tests for these in a separate pr

excerpts.content: <@520034910149410861> can you submit a PR which updates `is_head_weak` and `is_parent_strong` to properly use the updated `get_weight` function?

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: It's not obvious to me how to do this.

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Ah I see that you've updated `is_head_weak` in your "finishing touches" PR 🙂

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: We should update `is_parent_strong` there too.

excerpts.author: fradamt
excerpts.content:
I updated `is_parent_strong` there, had to change the input from `parent_root` to `root` because you need `root` to derive the `parent_node`, inclusive of `payload_status`, which is what we need for `get_weight`/`get_attestation_weight` . I decided to change the input to `root` everywhere, in other specs as well, to just have one consistent way of using the function throughout.

A note about `get_attestation_weight`: it was introduced to avoid an infinite loop in `is_head_weak`, since `should_apply_proposer_boost` in `get_weight` calls `is_head_weak` again. I think it makes sense to also use it in`is_parent_strong` to avoid proposer boot influencing the result.
